sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: emergency situations: collision avoidance, ABS, skids, drop-offs, vehicle malfunctions and breakdowns
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The stuck accelerator steps are reported in the printed order, engine off and then neutral; the dossier does not reorder or add to them [A05].
Physical page 105 introduces the malfunction list as preventive maintenance measures, but the items that follow are responses to failures; the dossier teaches them as responses [A03].
The statement that most new vehicles have ABS is the manual's own general claim with no figures, so none are added [A01].
Flare placement of about two hundred to three hundred feet behind the vehicle is reported as printed; the manual names no other warning device [A05].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
